meta.label: y_excess_20d
meta.ic_method: per-date cross-sectional Spearman vs y_excess_20d, min 100 names/date, averaged within month
meta.winsor_reference: 1/99 quantiles fit on labeled rows date <= 2026-02-25 (fold-1 harness view)

listing_age.definition: young_history = ret_252d is NaN (<252 sessions since first DB bar; in this pilot that is listing age OR late DB entry -- before 2026-03 EVERY ticker is 'young' because the DB starts 2025-03)
listing_age.caveat: identification only possible 2026-03 onward; pilot confounds true IPO age with DB start -- at 5y replace ret_252d_isnan with explicit listing_age_days

market_state.state_definition: per-date universe median mom_20 (trailing 20d return, point-in-time); date is 'up' if > 0; month state = sign of monthly mean of the per-date median

regime_break_2026_03.note: monthly IC means before vs from 2026-03 (the month after the -8.6pct median-20d crash of 2026-02). The vol family's sign flip is tied to this break, NOT to the trailing up/down state -- a trailing binary flag alone does not capture it.

liquidity_gradient.composite_definition: mean of per-date cs-rank-pct of the champion's 10 features, sign-aligned (cs_rank_mom_20 inverted), NaN-skipped

label_eda.note: y_excess_20d uses a 20-session overlapping window: adjacent daily ICs share 19/20 of their label window, so autocorrelation near (20-k)/20 is mechanical, not signal persistence. Autocorr clearly BELOW that baseline means the cross-sectional signal itself rotates within the window. Consequence for the 5y protocol: date-block bootstrap / monthly folds remain mandatory; daily ICs are not independent draws.

summary.note_short_history: mom_12_1/ret_252d excluded from the stability ranking (only 7 observable months); their own stats are in ic_stability
summary.liquidity_answer: edge NOT confined to the illiquid tail: composite IC illiquid 0.049 / mid 0.073 / liquid 0.058; delivery keeps ~2/3 of its IC in the liquid tercile

recommendation.feature_rebuild_verdict: targeted additions, not a wholesale rebuild
add: market_state (trailing universe median mom_20; universe drawdown / days-since-crash)
mom_12_1 x market_state and mom_12_1 x cs_rank_vol_20 interactions
log1p variants of vol family and cs_rank variants of raw return family (linear/NN pipelines only)
against_rebuild: champion runs on raw trees: winsorization/rank changes do not touch it
rank transforms add ~no univariate IC after winsorization
short-horizon features are noise -- adding more of them has negative expected value
10-feature subset already spans the two stable pillars (delivery + long momentum)
affects_5y_protocol: re-run feature selection on full history (vol/short-mom signs are regime-local; cs_rank_mom_20 inversion is a window artifact)
keep worst-fold floor headline metric (2026-03-type inversion months recur)

insights.finding: The volatility family is a regime variable, not alpha: atr_pct averaged -0.147 monthly IC for 9 straight months (2025-06..2026-02), then flipped to +0.091 from 2026-03 (post-crash junk rally). The CV window (Apr-Jul 2026) saw ONLY the positive phase, so the feature-selection '+' sign on atr_pct / cs_rank_vol_20 is regime-local and WILL invert at 5y scale.
insights.evidence: ic_stability.atr_pct monthly ICs (16 months, sign consistency 0.62, |mean| 0.043 < monthly std 0.147); market_state.regime_break_2026_03
insights.action: add_feature trailing market-state (universe median mom_20, universe drawdown/days-since-crash) so trees can condition vol features instead of learning one regime's sign

insights.finding: Delivery is the regime anchor: deliv_pct holds the same IC sign in 15/16 months (mean +0.069, t=4.35, the only feature with |mean IC| > its monthly std); deliv_pct_sma_20 mean +0.076 (t=3.37) and works in BOTH market states (IC +0.106 up / +0.059 down).
insights.action: keep_as_is (delivery block is the core; protect it in any rebuild)

insights.finding: Momentum pays only in up-tape: mom_12_1 daily IC +0.099 on up dates vs +0.013 on down dates (t of diff 4.11), and its deciles are U-shaped (deep losers also outperform) -- a linear term wastes it; trees or an explicit state interaction capture it.
insights.action: add_feature mom_12_1 x market_state interaction (and keep tree model); for the linear anchor use cs-rank of mom_12_1

insights.finding: 2026-03 is a common-mode inversion month: it is the worst (most adverse) IC month for 25 of 40 base features simultaneously, including every momentum/trend/delivery signal (features observed in post-crash March pointed the wrong way for April outcomes). This, not any model defect, is why fold 2026-04 was adversarial for every candidate.
insights.evidence: ic_stability.*.worst_month == 2026-03 for 25/40; composite worst month 2026-03 IC -0.138; market_state.month_table (2026-03 trailing median mom_20 -0.086 -> 2026-04 +0.065, sharpest V in sample)
insights.action: affects_5y_protocol (keep worst-fold floor as the headline stability metric; expect ~1-2 such months/cycle; a days-since-crash feature is the only feature-level mitigation)

insights.finding: One interaction earns a slot: momentum x volatility. The high-mom/high-vol corner returns +4.05% vs +3.81% additive (double-difference +1.05pp, same sign in 86% of months) -- 'junky' high-vol momentum beat quality momentum in this sample. This is what cs_rank_vol_20 is doing inside the champion (near-zero univariate IC, #2 permutation importance).
insights.action: add_feature explicit mom_12_1 x cs_rank_vol_20 product (gives the linear anchor what only trees see today); re-test corner at 5y -- high-vol-wins may itself be regime-local

insights.finding: Delivery does NOT confirm momentum: the deliv x mom_12_1 double-difference is -1.46pp (negative, 71% of months) -- delivery helps most where momentum is weak. They are substitutes (independent pillars), not a confirmation pair.
insights.action: keep_as_is (no deliv x mom product; diversification across the two pillars is the value)

insights.finding: Recently-listed names outperform within-month: young-history (ret_252d NaN) beats seasoned by +1.24pp/month on average (71% of the 7 identifiable months, t=2.25). The pooled gap is -0.51pp (opposite sign) -- a calendar confound: before 2026-03 every ticker is 'young' because the DB starts 2025-03. ret_252d_isnan's tree gain (#13) is partly this real effect, partly imputation artifact.
insights.action: add_feature listing_age_days (sessions since first bar) + is_recent_listing flag at 5y; do not rely on ret_252d_isnan as the carrier

insights.finding: Tails are pathological for anything non-tree: atr_pct skew 95 / excess kurtosis ~13,900; macd_norm skew -87; vol_20 kurtosis ~3,300; dist_52w_low skew 32. Harness 1/99 winsorization leaves 2.0-3.4% of post-train rows clipped (vs 2% if stationary) -- mild drift, concentrated in 1d-return features.
insights.action: transform vol family (vol_5/10/20, atr_pct, vol_ratio_20, range_pct, dist_52w_low) with log1p and return family (ret_63/126/252d, mom_*, macd_norm) with cs_rank -- for linear/NN pipelines only; champion trees run raw and are unaffected

insights.finding: Cross-sectional rank does NOT materially improve univariate linear IC once harness winsorization is applied: |t| gain from ranking the champion 10 ranges -0.44 to +0.24 (only dist_52w_high and atr_pct improve). Ranks' value is model-side (tree splits, scale-free across regimes), not signal-side.
insights.evidence: rank_transform_test (monthly Pearson IC, winsorized-raw vs cs-rank)
insights.action: keep_as_is (do NOT rebuild all features as ranks; add rank variants only for the skewed momentum/vol blocks above)

insights.finding: cs_rank_mom_20's inverted ('-') univariate sign is a CV-window artifact: full-sample mean IC is +0.009 with sign consistency 0.50 (a coin flip). It is the weakest champion member and its contribution direction cannot be trusted across regimes.
insights.action: affects_5y_protocol (re-run feature selection on full history before freezing the subset; cs_rank_mom_20 is the first candidate to fall out)

insights.finding: The short-horizon block is dead weight: mom_5/10, dist_sma_5/10/20, ret_1d/log_ret_1d, rsi_2, gap_pct, vol_z_20, flag_split_20d all have |t| < 1 and sign consistency <= 0.56 over 16 months. None of the 30 non-champion features clears monthly noise.
insights.action: drop short-horizon raw block from linear/NN variants (keeps 51->~25 cols); harmless but useless for trees -- confirms the 10-feature subset decision

insights.finding: No capacity red flag: the edge does not live in the illiquid tail. Composite top-10 IC by turnover tercile: illiquid +0.049, mid +0.073, liquid +0.058; delivery fades with liquidity (+0.101 -> +0.065) but keeps ~2/3 of its IC in the liquid tercile; momentum is actually strongest mid/liquid. Dispersion is flat across terciles (~7.1-7.5%).
insights.action: keep_as_is (report to management: strategy is deployable beyond the illiquid tail; monitor deliv IC decay with liquidity at 5y)

insights.finding: No intra-month signal decay beyond label overlap: mom_12_1 daily-IC autocorrelation (lag1..5: 0.9684, 0.9345, 0.896, 0.8606, 0.8206) sits AT or ABOVE the mechanical overlap baseline (0.95/0.90/0.85/0.80/0.75). Signals are slow; a 20d horizon with monthly refresh loses nothing, and daily ICs are nearly fully dependent draws.
insights.action: affects_5y_protocol (date-block bootstrap and monthly purged folds remain mandatory; never compute significance on daily rows)

insights.finding: Delivery's IC halved after the crash: deliv_pct_sma_20 monthly IC averaged ~+0.13 in 2025 but only ~+0.04 over the 2026 test months (worst -0.143 in 2026-03). Still positive and the most consistent signal, but the pilot's CV window UNDERSTATES delivery relative to its long-run average -- and a structural fade would hit the champion hardest.
insights.action: affects_5y_protocol (add delivery-IC drift monitor to the 5y run; re-estimate delivery weight on full history)

insights.finding: Opportunity set is healthy and stable: per-month cross-sectional std of y_excess_20d ranges 8.7% (2025-11) to 12.3% (2026-05) -- no dead months; decile-spread economics are comparable across folds.
